query: Is the proposed AD for EMBRAER ERJ 170 series engine fire handle inspections (docket FAA-2005-20501) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal was withdrawn. The original NPRM was issued 2005-02-28 and proposed inspecting and, if necessary, replacing the engine fire handles on the overhead panel. On 2005-05-23 the FAA withdrew it because new data showed the unsafe condition had been corrected. It is no longer active and there is no open comment deadline.

query: Is the proposed AD under docket 95-NM-215-AD for Boeing 737-100/-200 airplanes (frame at BS 727 and stringer 18A crack inspections) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: No longer active. The 2001-07-02 document revised the earlier proposal (a supplemental NPRM), but on 2010-05-04 the FAA withdrew that supplemental NPRM. The proposed superseding AD will not be adopted, and the existing AD requiring the inspections stays in effect.

query: Is the FAA proposal under docket FAA-2024-1884, which would have superseded AD 2023-08-04 for Boeing 787-8, 787-9, and 787-10 airplanes, still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. In doc 2025-02069, issued 2025-01-28, the FAA withdrew the NPRM that proposed to supersede AD 2023-08-04 for certain Boeing 787-8, 787-9, and 787-10 airplanes. That NPRM was prompted by reports of loss of water pressure in flight and water leaks affecting electronic equipment, and by the discovery that some clamshell couplings did not meet requirements. The withdrawal is the latest entry in the docket, so no comment deadline remains open.

query: Is the proposed AD for Erickson Air-Crane S-64E and S-64F helicopters under docket FAA-2007-0373, covering tail rotor blade cracking inspections, still an active proposal, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: No longer active. The FAA published the original NPRM on 2007-11-28 proposing inspections of tail rotor blade assemblies. On 2021-03-08 (doc 2021-05219) the FAA withdrew that NPRM, so the proposed AD will not be adopted as proposed and no comment deadline remains open.

query: What is the current status of the proposed airworthiness directive in docket FAA-2024-1475 covering Airbus A319, A320, and A321 airplanes? Is it still an active proposal, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The FAA withdrew the NPRM in document 2024-11214, issued 2024-09-19. The notice would have adopted a new AD for certain Airbus SAS A319, A320, and A321 models. Because it was withdrawn, no AD will be issued from it and there is no open comment deadline.
